description: This file contains unit tests for the Promote model within the Goteo project, covering creation, validation, localization, deletion, and cleanup processes.

classes.name: PromoteTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing functionality of the Promote model, including creation, validation, localization, deletion, and cleanup.

methods.name: testInstance
methods.description: Tests that a Promote object can be instantiated.

methods.name: testValidate
methods.description: Checks validation and save behavior of the Promote object without associated project.

methods.name: testSavePromoteNonProject
methods.description: Tests saving a Promote object when no project is associated, expects failure.

methods.name: testCreateProject
methods.description: Creates and verifies a test project for use in other tests.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Creates and validates a Promote object attached to a project, then verifies its data.

methods.name: testSaveLanguages
methods.description: Tests setting language-specific data on the Promote object.

methods.name: testCheckLanguages
methods.description: Verifies localization behavior by switching languages and checking data consistency.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Tests deleting a Promote object and then verifying it no longer exists.

methods.name: testNonExisting
methods.description: Verifies behavior when attempting to retrieve or delete a non-existent Promote object.

methods.name: tearDownAfterClass
methods.description: Performs cleanup operations after all tests are run.
